taf.halt.cloud_not_resumed: KIFF resumed {taf}, but tafs cloud didn't yet. {why}
taf.halt.cloud_not_resumed_all: KIFF resumed your tafs, but tafs cloud didn't yet. {why}
taf.halt.connection_sends_nothing: The connection sends nothing to your apps
taf.halt.halted_with_all: Halted with all your tafs. Resume them all to let it run.
taf.halt.halting_wait: Halting… waiting for every part to confirm.
taf.halt.title: Halt
taf.memory.empty: Nothing yet. It writes down what it learns about how you like the job done.
taf.memory.explains: Every run and chat starts with these. They shape how it works, never what its Card allows. Forget removes that one note and its earlier versions; past chats and run reports stay until the taf is removed.
taf.memory.forget_body:
“{note}”

It can't be undone: the taf stops working with it from its next run or chat. Other notes stay.
taf.memory.title: What it remembers
taf.not_live_version_card_taf: Not on the live version's Card: the taf doesn't use it now. Going back to an older version may need it.

taf.remove.cards_left.one: KIFF didn't revoke {count} of its Cards: revoke them in KIFF.
taf.remove.cards_left.other: KIFF didn't revoke {count} of its Cards: revoke them in KIFF.

taf.remove.cards_revoked: Its Cards are revoked in KIFF.
taf.remove.cloud_did_not_answer: {cards} tafs cloud didn't answer ({why}). If it began, tafs finishes it the next time it refreshes; if not, tap Remove again.

taf.remove.connections_left.one: {count} of its connections couldn't be disconnected: disconnect them in Connect apps.
taf.remove.connections_left.other: {count} of its connections couldn't be disconnected: disconnect them in Connect apps.

taf.remove.done: Its schedule, chats, run reports, memory and key are deleted, and the name {taf} is free. KIFF's receipts stay.
taf.remove.finishes_on_refresh: If the removal began, tafs finishes it the next time it refreshes.
taf.remove.not_finished: Not finished: its {steps} couldn't be removed. tafs tries again each time it refreshes.
taf.remove.not_finished_after: {cards} Not finished: its {failed} couldn't be removed. tafs tries again each time it refreshes.
taf.remove_body: Its Cards are revoked, its schedule stopped, its chats, run reports, memory and key deleted, and its name freed. KIFF's receipts stay.
taf.report.when_run_ends: Its report shows here when the run ends.
taf.revoke_body: No new action goes through. Anything already done stays done.
taf.signed_tools_being_chosen: Signed in · the tools are being chosen
taf.signed_tools_waiting_your_approval: Signed in · tools waiting for your approval
taf.try_version_first_you_chat: Try a version first: you chat with it under a Card of its own, while the live version keeps working. Installing one makes it the live version.
taf.unless_you_approve_tools_sign: Unless you approve its tools, the sign-in is revoked {time}.
taf.workflow.title: Workflow
taf.works_from_chat: It works when you tell it, in its chat: no schedule runs it.
